svg.title: Twin-Track Jing-Zhang: one ordinary task, three non-interchangeable spatial relations
svg.desc: G0 conceptual spatial atlas. Zhongzhiyuan organizes an ordinary parallel bypass, Origin Community joins two courts with one resident street, and Dazhongsi organizes the ordinary task around a four-way commuter cross. All ordinary paths are continuous without AI; proof, stop, staffed handoff and recovery layers follow separately.
svg.text: TWIN-TRACK JING-ZHANG · THREE CIVIC SWITCHYARDS · G0 · PROVISIONAL · NOT TO SCALE
One ordinary task works first; three places protect it through different spatial relations
This layer shows the ordinary/non-AI baseline only. Proof, stop, staffed handoff and recovery are added separately and never become authorization, approval or G1.

g.text: 01 VERIFY · ZHONGZHIYUAN
Parallel bypass: ordinary life is separate from side work
The ordinary task is to pass, ask, bypass or exit along the continuous green route.
Outside the court edge
The ordinary bypass does not enter the side court
Ordinary bypass / continuous non-AI path
Pass · ask · bypass · exit
The diagram does not establish:
an existing court, equipment, dimensions, materials, connections or accessibility result.
02 CO-CREATE · ORIGIN COMMUNITY
One street, two courts: resident life makes the main route
The ordinary task is to pass, pause, exchange, ask for help or leave on the screen-free resident street.
Question court
Civic review court
Resident street / screen-free ordinary passage continues
Walk · pause · exchange · ask for help · exit
The diagram does not establish:
existing courts, resident consent, accessibility, service hours or an operating commitment.
03 PUBLISH · DAZHONGSI
Four-way commuter cross: commuting does not become a service queue
The ordinary task is to pass, orient, ask, rest quietly or exit through four directions.
Four-way commuting / physical orientation / non-AI continues
Pass · orient · ask · rest quietly · exit
The diagram does not establish:
an existing station, road, footfall, staffed desk, queue or site approval.

svg.text: Ordinary-first: each place provides a same-task non-AI route, staffed explanation and safe exit before any side proof; their spatial grammars are parallel bypass, one street/two courts and a four-way commuter cross.
G0 conceptual relations only: no precise location, existing building, real accessibility, staff, roster, service, approval, recovery duration or result is shown; RIGHTS = not_fully_cleared.
The spatial atlas is not a site plan, engineering drawing or authorization state.
